description: Adds or updates a collapsible section that groups related canvas blocks under a titled header (CanvasBlock with type section). Add the section before any block that references it. Blocks join a section by setting their `section_id` to this section's `identifier`; each section lays out its blocks on its own 3-column grid starting at row 0.

identifier.description: Unique key for this section (e.g. `saturation`, `error_rates`). Must be unique among canvas blocks in this job.

title.description: Section header shown above its blocks (e.g. `Saturation`).

description.description: Optional one-sentence explanation of what the section shows, shown behind an info icon.

position.description: Order of this section among sections (0-based). Sections render below any unsectioned blocks.

collapsed.description: Whether the section starts collapsed. Use for supporting detail the reader rarely needs.
